activities.name: raw_process_movement
activities.description:
This notebook will leverage the Healthcare Data Solutions library to move/extract (extract ZIP files and move) files for multiple HDS modalities, which contain various namespaces and file extensions. This framework will move/extract (extract ZIP files and move) files based on the 'file_orchestration_config' configuration, which contains mapping details such as modality, modality_format, extension etc.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: claims_landing_zone_delta_tables_ingestion
activities.description: This notebook ingests claims data files from a configurable drop folder and organizes them into a structured folder hierarchy based on date (yyyy/mm/dd). It processes the files and populates the corresponding delta tables.

activities.name: claims_fhir_conversion
activities.description: This notebook leverages the TransformToFHIRNDJSON function from the Healthcare Data Solutions library to convert claims data from the respective delta tables into various FHIR resources—such as Claims and ExplanationOfBenefit—in the Bronze Fhir4.3 format. The output is saved as ndjson files.

activities.name: fhir_ndjson_bronze_ingestion
activities.description:
This notebook activity facilitates the ingestion of FHIR ndjson data into Delta tables within the bronze lake house.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: bronze_silver_flatten
activities.description:
This notebook activity transforms and flattens the data from the bronze lake house and ingests the data into the silver lake house.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.
